categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing industry, specifically focusing on automotive fluid management systems and related components. Main product lines include: (1) Automotive fluid pipeline assemblies (汽车流体管路及总成) - including fuel systems, evaporative emission systems, vacuum brake systems, and new energy vehicle thermal management systems; (2) Automotive fluid control components and precision injection molded parts (汽车流体控制件及精密注塑件); (3) Other products including fasteners and structural components. The company serves over 30 OEM manufacturers and 100+ automotive parts suppliers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in nylon-based plastic fluid management systems using advanced manufacturing techniques. Core technologies include: (1) Quick-connect coupling technology for automotive pipelines - the company pioneered the first automotive nylon fuel line quick connector in 2003; (2) Fluid control valve technology; (3) Multi-layer plastic pipe manufacturing; (4) Precision injection molding for complex components; (5) Automated assembly and sealing detection systems. The company employs lean manufacturing (JIT), flexible production lines, ERP system integration, and has achieved IATF16949:2016 and General Motors BIQS quality certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major Chinese OEMs (长安汽车, 比亚迪, 上汽通用五菱, 赛力斯, 奇瑞汽车, 北京汽车, 一汽解放) and emerging EV manufacturers (理想, 合众, 小鹏, 零跑). The company also serves leading battery manufacturers (宁德时代, 国轩高科, 中创新航) and energy storage system integrators. End markets include passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, new energy vehicles, and energy storage systems. In 2023, new energy vehicle business represented approximately 43% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Chongqing (headquarters), Liuzhou (Guangxi), and Liyang (Jiangsu). Sales are distributed across major Chinese regions: South China (38.76% of 2023 revenue), Southwest (23.41%), East China (25.41%), North China (5.06%), Central China (5.19%), and Northeast (2.17%). The company is expanding internationally through customer export requirements and plans to establish overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive supplier. As Tier 1, it supplies directly to OEMs; as Tier 2, it supplies to major Tier 1 suppliers including global leaders like Bosch, Inergy (oil tank supplier), and Japanese pipe system suppliers. The company has vertically integrated upstream by developing in-house capabilities for quick connectors, control valves, precision molds, and tooling, reducing dependence on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Expanding new energy vehicle thermal management systems - developing battery cooling, motor cooling, and integrated thermal solutions; (2) Developing hydrogen fuel cell and alternative fuel systems; (3) Advancing material substitution from metal to plastic (以塑代钢); (4) Expanding into energy storage, charging infrastructure, and air suspension systems; (5) Pursuing overseas market expansion; (6) Enhancing automation and digitalization of manufacturing; (7) Developing integrated fluid control solutions combining pipes, connectors, and valves. R&D investment was 5.08% of revenue in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive components to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Revenue recognition occurs when: (1) For OEM customers - when products are withdrawn from third-party logistics warehouses; (2) For parts manufacturer customers - when products are received and confirmed at customer facilities. The company uses a make-to-order production model based on customer forecasts and orders. In 2023, automotive fluid pipeline assemblies represented 87.15% of revenue, with fluid control components at 10.65%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of automotive nylon fluid management systems. International competitors include TI Automotive, Cooper-Standard, Norma, Francosche, and Sanoh (Japan). Domestic competitors include Lingyun Group's subsidiary Yada Automotive and Biaobang. The company differentiates through: (1) Early market entry and technology leadership in nylon quick connectors; (2) Vertical integration of component manufacturing; (3) Strong relationships with leading Chinese OEMs and battery manufacturers; (4) Rapid response capabilities for new vehicle development; (5) Comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple vehicle systems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized automotive supplier with significant growth trajectory. 2023 revenue was RMB 1,010.5 million (up 19% YoY), with net profit of RMB 150.8 million (down 1.74% YoY). Total assets grew 132% to RMB 2,298.9 million, primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in June 2023, raising RMB 1,184.3 million in net proceeds. Operating cash flow was RMB 88.2 million in 2023. The company has demonstrated consistent profitability with gross margins around 28% for core products.
